title: Make your brand instantly recognizable across channels
summary: Twilio posts cloud communications trends, customer stories, and tips for building scalable voice and SMS applications with Twilio's APIs.
body_markdown:
## Make your brand instantly recognizable across channels with Twilio Branded Communications


With spam, spoofing, and AI fraud everywhere, people increasingly ignore any call or message they can't verify. For businesses, that means fraud alerts go unread, lab results get missed, and carts get abandoned.


Trust is earned when every interaction is unmistakably you. When your name, logo, and verified status show up on every call, text, and email, customers know it's you before they decide whether to engage. Nearly[half of consumers](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/lp/consumer-preferences-report) say they'd trust a message a lot more if it carried a verified logo or check mark.


## Trust is a two way street


A delivered message can be considered a success but if no one engages[it is actually a failure](https://www.ciodive.com/spons/black-friday-is-a-stress-test-for-customer-trust/874140/) . When customers recognize you, they engage. CareSignal used[Branded Calling](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/voice/branded-calling) to put its verified name on outbound calls, and answer rates went up 21%.


Your customers move between channels, and that trust should move with them. Someone might hear from you through text message to reschedule an appointment in the morning, then receive a call to confirm attendance at lunch and then an email in the evening recapping the appointment scheduling.


When each one carries the same verified brand, the trust you earned on the call carries over to the text and the email.[Fresha](https://customers.twilio.com/en-us/fresha) saw this with RCS. Branded, verified messages hit 40% read rates, 6% more customers confirmed appointments than over SMS, and post-visit engagement like reviews and tips went up 5 to 7%.


As AI agents become ubiquitous and operating all day, starting conversations for you will require them to show up as your brand to establish trust. Consistency is what builds confidence, on every channel and every new way you reach out.


## Twilio helps you lead with your brand everywhere


Showing up as your brand on every channel usually means a different vendor, verification process, and dashboard for each one. Twilio brings it all together:


**Register once, brand everywhere**


With[Trust Hub](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/trust-hub) , you set up one verified Business Profile and use it across Voice, and messaging. Your team manages brand identity and verification from one place instead of running a separate vendor and process for each channel.


**Build it into what you already run**


Branded Communications works with the same Twilio APIs you already use for calls, messages, and email. Verification standards like STIR/SHAKEN for voice and BIMI and DMARC for email are part of the same setup. Your developers add branding to existing workflows without building a new integration for each channel. Rollout timing depends on channel support, region, and configuration.


**Prove it's working**


Branding should pay for itself, and you should be able to see that it does. Twilio Insights shows how your branded outreach performs across[Voice](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/voice/insights) ,[Messaging](https://www.twilio.com/docs/messaging/features/messaging-insights/dashboards) , and[Email](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/ui/analytics-and-reporting/deliverability-insights) , from answer and read rates to delivery and where customers drop off. Use it to fix what's underperforming, invest in what's working, and feed those signals into your automation and AI workflows.


## Lead the shift to trusted customer communications


Every call, text, and email is a chance to show up as your brand. The businesses customers recognize across voice, messaging, and email are the ones that get the answer, the reply, and the next conversation.


With[Twilio Branded Communications](https://twilio.com/en-us/cpaas/branded-communications) , the trust you build on every channel becomes your greatest advantage. Walk through the[Branded Communications interactive demo](https://twilio.coastdemo.com/share/6ad7c85543b009f0bebb627e) to see it in action.
